summary: A high school student shares daily moments, test scores, and fun vlog clips about balancing study and life. They also celebrate reaching a big follower milestone and unbox an exciting surprise package.

phrases.pron: xī wàng nǐ xǐ huan ba
phrases.usage: Say this with a warm smile when sharing a gift, drawing, or video with a friend.
phrases.example: 这是我画的，希望你喜欢吧！
phrases.example_pron: zhè shì wǒ huà de, xī wàng nǐ xǐ huan ba!
phrases.example_en: I drew this, hope you like it!

phrases.usage: A friendly, cheerful greeting to say when you enter a room or join a group call.
phrases.example_pron: lǎo shī, tóng xué men, dà jiā hǎo ya!

phrases.usage: Use this when you start yawning or your eyes feel heavy during class or bedtime.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ yī tīng gù shi jiù fàn kùn.
phrases.example_en: I get sleepy as soon as I hear a story.

phrases.usage: A sweet way to tell family members or friends goodnight right before sleeping.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ yào shuì jiào le, wǎn ān dà jiā!
phrases.example_en: I am going to bed, good night everyone!

phrases.usage: Say this to remind someone to bring an umbrella when you see raindrops outside.
phrases.example: 外面下雨了，带上雨伞吧。
phrases.example_pron: wài mian xià yǔ le, dài shang yǔ sǎn ba.
phrases.example_en: It is raining outside, take an umbrella.

phrases.usage: Use this word when ordering delicious meals from a restaurant to your house.
phrases.example: 今天晚上我们吃外卖吧！
phrases.example_pron: jīn tiān wǎn shang wǒ men chī wài mài ba!

phrases.usage: Say this when you unexpectedly bump into a friend at the park or store.
phrases.example_pron: zài zhè lǐ jiàn dào nǐ, hǎo qiǎo ya!
phrases.example_en: Seeing you here, what a coincidence!

phrases.usage: Use this playful phrase when you have a secret gift or surprise to show someone.
phrases.example: 我手里有糖，猜猜是什么？
phrases.example_pron: wǒ shǒu lǐ yǒu táng, cāi cai shì shén me?
phrases.example_en: I have candy in my hand, guess what it is?

phrases.quote: 我会继续努力的鼓掌哦
phrases.usage: A motivating phrase to encourage your friends or yourself to do your best.
phrases.example: 考得不错，下次继续努力！
phrases.example_pron: kǎo de bù cuò, xià cì jì xù nǔ lì!
phrases.example_en: Good test score, keep working hard next time!

phrases.usage: Use this lively phrase when the winter wind is freezing or ice feels extra cold.
phrases.example_pron: dōng tiān zhè lǐ chāo jí chāo jí lěng.
phrases.example_en: It is super super cold here in winter.
